pattern.description: Regular expression over file contents. For a fixed call or code shape, use `syntax: "code"` instead of escaping.

path.description: File or directory to search under, relative to the working directory. Omit for the whole tree.

glob.description: Glob filter, e.g. `*.rs` or `*.{ts,tsx}`. A `/` makes it match paths, not just file names.

-A.description: Context lines after each match (content mode).

-B.description: Context lines before each match (content mode).

-C.description: Context lines before and after each match (content mode). Alias for `context`.

context.description: Context lines before and after each match (content mode).

-n.description: Show line numbers in content mode (default true).

offset.description: Skip the first N results (default 0), to page through more.

multiline.description: Let `.` match newlines (default false). Regex mode only.

syntax.description: `regex` (default), or `code` for code-shape matching with `$NAME`, `$...NAME`, and `...` metavariables.

constraints.description: Code mode only: keep a match only when each named capture matches its regex.

metavariable.description: Capture name to test, e.g. `FUNC` (leading `$` optional).

regex.description: Regex the capture must match. Anchor with `^...$`.
